name: Phone
description: Your phone in ewe: a dock button with its apps (real icons, open here or on the phone) and its files, pairing, battery, notifications and SMS on the Mobile page, a phone glyph in the bar. No KDE Connect window anywhere.
author: prj786

settings.label: Hide KDE Connect’s own windows
settings.description: Takes KDE Connect’s launcher entries (app, SMS, indicator, settings) out of the launcher so ewe Mobile is the only face. Off puts them back.
